Question: After completing written addition, what method is commonly used to check the answer?

Choices.A: Use subtraction: subtract one addend from the sum and check whether the result equals the other addend.
Choices.B: Multiply the two addends together again.
Choices.C: Look only at the ones column and ignore the other place values.

Solution: Subtraction is commonly used to check addition: subtracting one addend from the sum should give the other addend.
